versions.changelog: For WilmAI CLI 2.0 (or the WilmAI MCP tools). One summary --since <last run> call covers every child with one login; works with any calendar tool; notices new replies in message threads; dates in the reader's language style.
Wording fix: remove city- and brand-specific references (municipality notices phrased generically, generic trip examples). No behavioral changes.

Download and read important bulletin attachments: new workflow step inspects the resources array, downloads genuine document attachments on high-value bulletins, and handles downloaded / not_a_file / error statuses. What-not-to-download guidance and sandbox path caveat included. Requires wilma-cli 1.6.0+ (wilma skill 1.6.0).

Add day-before logistics extraction from viikkoviestit. Triage now surfaces modified start times, what to bring, cancelled lessons, and return times from weekly teacher letters for upcoming days — even when the event is already on the calendar.
Add attendance/lesson notes (merkinnät) to triage workflow: fetch yesterday's notes in morning runs, report behavioral concerns and unexplained absences, skip positive notes by default

- Added an `openclaw` metadata block specifying required binaries, skills, configuration paths, and credential notes for setup.
- Clarified the need for local Wilma credentials and Google Calendar (gog CLI) authentication in the metadata. 
- No changes to core logic or workflow; documentation and dependency requirements improved for easier setup and integration.
Initial release: automated daily triage for Finnish parents, Google Calendar sync, smart message classification
